keys.swarm.aura_venom_trail_desc: A venom snake slithers after the nearest monsters. Its bite hurts, and its body damages and slows monsters it crosses.
keys.swarm.aura_shadow_clone_desc: You leave a shadow at your position. It echoes basic attacks, your ultimate, and nova and projectile skills at 20% damage. When you leap, it leaps at the enemy nearest to it.
keys.swarm.aura_shadow_clone_up: More clones at once, lasting longer (up to 3).
keys.swarm.aura_shadow_clone_ten: Shadow Legion: up to 6 clones, each bursting when its duration ends.
